newsitem.title: USA: US Plains cattle trade nil after brisk sales-trade.
newsitem.headline: US Plains cattle trade nil after brisk sales-trade.

text.p: U.S. central and southern Plains feedlot cattle markets were quiet early Friday with no bids or sales reported following active sales Thursday at $66 per cwt, cattle feeders said.
Packers came in after CME futures trade ended and USDA offices closed on Thursday and aggressively bought cattle following light sales earlier in the day.
About 35,000 head sold Thursday in the Texas Panhandle/ western Oklahoma area and about 35,000 in Kansas, but totals may be larger once the late sales are tallied, they said.
